pkgmetadata.longdescription: Youta-bin installs Youta's official prebuilt Linux release for amd64, arm64, or SSE2-capable x86. The binary includes upstream's fixed default provider set, terminal UI, mpv playback backend, yt-dlp integration, tracker-module support, read-only ZIP/RAR Local folders, and the human-readable state backend. The gui USE flag adds the desktop executable without replacing the TUI. Terminal image rendering and offline QR codes are selected independently with the images and qr USE flags; SQLite is not included. Install media-sound/youta instead when granular build-time feature selection or a non-glibc target is required.

use.flag: Install the official desktop GUI executable alongside the terminal executable.
